name: Angular webapp
summary: A browser application with standalone Angular components; also the project-setup starter for an existing Git + Obsidian vault.
outcome: A reviewed prototype package with web application source (Angular), ready for explicit dependency resolution and implementation.
includes: Shared core in src/core with stable page data
Web application entrypoint and local preview server
Offline single-file prototype build (npm run build:prototype)
Exact dependency pins with a root-only lock for explicit resolution
implementation: Agree the prototype brief in the interview before any files are written
Implement the agreed visual components and business actions
Resolve dependencies explicitly, then typecheck, test and build every target
nextSteps: Review execution-prompt.md and source/README.md in the prepared package.
In source/, run npm install, then npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run build.
Run npm start for a local preview on 127.0.0.1:4173.
For an existing vault, node bin/app project-setup uses this starter and keeps first run separately approved.
